description: A Late - Post Roman cemetery, dated from the 4th CE to the late 7th or early 8th CE. At the highest part of the hill is a circular rock-cut trench with traces of a revetment, this is thought to have been a shrine/temple/mausoleum (these seem to be roughly synonymous terms here) that acted as a focus of the cemetery. Dating of this structure is uncertain.
bibliography: Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Cannington Cemetery (Somerset).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.

Rhatz, Hirst, and Wright. “Cannington Cemetery. Excavations 1962-3 of Prehistoric, Roman, Post-Roman and Later Features at Cannington Park Quarry, near Bridgwater, Somerset.” Britannia Monograph Series 17 (2000).
